summary: Extension authors build domain-specific connection profiles (databases, storage, APIs) on top of this package. The primary extension surface is: define a ProfileDescriptor with ParameterSpec entries, create a Registry, subclass DescriptorProfile with __descriptor__, and optionally implement a custom __adapter__ or override _auth_kwargs(). Auth modes are extended by subclassing AuthSpec and registering in AUTH_TO_DRIVER_KWARGS.

concepts.name: Defining a profile descriptor
recommended_docs: ProfileDescriptor: name, provider_type, parameters, auth_modes, metadata
ParameterSpec: name (UPPERCASE), type, tier, default, driver_key, secret, transform, validator, template

concepts.name: Registering and using a profile class
Auth mode extension
recommended_docs: Add to AUTH_TO_DRIVER_KWARGS for default dispatch
Or override _auth_kwargs() in your DescriptorProfile subclass

concepts.name: Invariant test coverage
recommended_docs: TestInvariants = descriptor_invariants_for(MY_REGISTRY) — drop in test module for automatic invariant coverage
Invariants checked: name lowercase, param names UPPERCASE, driver_keys unique, auth_modes non-empty AuthSpec, provider_type not None

concepts.name: Secret fields in profiles
recommended_docs: ParameterSpec(secret=True) wraps field as SecretStr automatically

concepts.name: Template-derived fields in profiles
recommended_docs: Template only applies when current value matches the declared default (explicit user values win)
